title: Exit reachability
hypothesis: Labelling every exit foot, water or none from one whole-map flood, and dropping the ones the player cannot walk to from the exit lists and navigate_to messages (ROUTE104's NORTH edge and the PETALBURG WOODS north mouths were listed as untaken exits from the south half, where the flood reaches 546 tiles and none above y=38, and navigate_to said "call navigate_to again to continue to (12,0)" in runs 0e05 and 93eb; the person refusal called MAY on ROUTE103 unreachable 11 times in 4198 though her neighbours are walkable via the west), stops models walking at exits they cannot reach, so more runs enter PETALBURG WOODS, in fewer turns.
notes: Bundle arm only (operator decision the operator 2026-10-17 2:02 PM New York): the config owner turns it on in the bundle arm of bundle-v-control, which is owned elsewhere and not edited here. Uses the finals incumbent of story-destinations with only exit-reachability-v1 flipped. Activation: the earliest recorded case is the MAY refusal on ROUTE103 (4198 T592); the frontier case is ROUTE104's north half, reached only through PETALBURG WOODS (0e05 T890, 93eb). The water-only labels act only together with surf-gated-exits-v1, which the finals incumbent has off. Not designed (pokebench-experiment-design) and not queued. Provisional source.commit is this branch's M2 RED commit; repin to the merge SHA with `just experiment-pin` when it lands.
